$comment: Curated draft-pick truth the NBA player-movement feed cannot supply. The feed marks pick movement only as a 'draft consideration' leg (PLAYER_ID 0) with no year/round, and it records draft selections only as later 'Rookie Scale Contract' signings. Each trade entry is keyed by the feed's GroupSort; derive attaches the listed picks to that transaction. draft_selection entries create a node where a pick strand ends and a player strand begins. Rows with verified:false are drafts to be confirmed by the owner (RealGM / Basketball-Reference trade pages); an empty picks list means 'not curated yet' and derive records the leg with a note while validate warns.
